/** Resolve a key id to its raw signing material, or throw if the id is unknown. */
export function keyForId(kid: string): Buffer {
  const hex = KEYRING[kid];
  if (!hex) {
    throw new Error(`unknown key id: ${JSON.stringify(kid)}`);
  }
  return Buffer.from(hex, "hex");
}
